answer: The ivory test starts from the attacker's ledger: a thousand fake agents should cost a thousand times one honest agent. A stake that vests on good behaviour turns each fake into a hostage: behave and it returns, spam and it is gone. The nadir prices misbehaviour directly — the attacker must fund every clone up front and loses the stake on every clone the graders catch. The prism turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
